shared_elements: low-relief carving on a large upright stone slab/monolith
schematic anthropomorphic face or head with prominent eyes/nose
dense, low-relief surface covered in abstract symbolic forms
register-like horizontal division of the composition
justification: Both surfaces are upright slabs carved in shallow relief with a schematic frontal head-like configuration at the top (broad brow band, deep eyes, central nose) above a lower zone of packed curvilinear and scroll-like motifs, and both include a distinct disc/ring element among the abstract forms. However, A reads as a single columnar body with a torso, arms and a large central disc worn on the chest, while B is a rectangular panel filled with multiple small clustered figures/glyph-like elements in horizontal registers, so the internal relationships between elements differ substantially.
